prompt: ripgrep NUL bytes handling without text flag
answer:
Without `-a/--text`, ripgrep treats a file containing a NUL byte as binary and stops searching it. It also replaces NUL bytes with line terminators, which helps prevent excessive memory use when processing binary data.

Sources: [issue #2809](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/2809), [issue #2831](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/2831)
